messages.subject: Engagement — Pennine Mutual SaaS Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Nadia,

Thank you for instructing us on the proposed Master SaaS and Data Services Agreement with Pennine Mutual for the Helio platform. Please find attached our engagement letter setting out scope, the team (Sarah Whitfield leading, with me on day-to-day conduct and Elena Marchetti supporting) and our fee estimate of £28,000–£36,000 plus VAT.

Grateful if you could sign and return the enclosed copy. We will start on the heads of terms this week.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
